about_the_game:
In Grit & Gold, you inherit a rugged piece of land on the edge of the frontier. Armed with little more than determination, you’ll carve out a homestead and fund your dream life by mining for precious gold in the surrounding hills, rivers, and abandoned shafts.

Mine gold, smelt it into bars, and sell it for cash to expand your homestead. Order tools, furniture, and upgrades through a mock in-game internet shop, and watch your land transform from a humble shack into a thriving property.

Play casually at your own pace — explore mining zones, gather resources, and slowly shape a home that reflects your style. With no hunger meters or survival stress, Grit & Gold is a relaxed, creative experience that rewards patience and imagination.

Features

  • 🏡 Homestead Building – Design and upgrade your personal plot of land with furniture, workshops, and expansions.

  • ⛏️ Gold Mining Zones – Travel to rich veins and riverbeds to dig up ore, nuggets, and rare finds.

  • 🔥 Ore to Riches – Smelt raw ore into gold bars and trade them for cash.

  • 🛒 In-Game Internet Shop – Use your earnings to order items, furniture, and upgrades straight to your homestead.

  • 🌄 Open-World Atmosphere – Explore a beautiful frontier landscape with high-quality visuals.

  • ♾️ Endless Progression – Gold veins naturally replenish over time, so there’s always another strike waiting.

  • 🎨 Future Expansions – Optional DLCs will add farming, animal breeding, new mining zones, and more.

Grit & Gold is free to play, with optional DLC packs available to expand your homestead. It also serves as a showcase for the systems powering our upcoming open-world game Coastline Survival — letting you enjoy a casual, creative experience now while looking forward to what’s next.
